48:16.text: to the bedouins who lagged behind: "You shall be called to fight against a people given to great warfare, then you shall fight them, or they shall surrender. Then if you obey, Allâh will give you a fair reward; but if you turn away as you did turn away before, He will punish you with a painful torment."

48:17.text: No blame or sin is there upon the blind, nor is there blame or sin upon the lame, nor is there blame or sin upon the sick
. And whosoever obeys Allâh and His Messenger
, He will admit him to Gardens beneath which rivers flow
; and whosoever turns back, He will punish him with a painful torment.

48:18.text: Indeed, Allâh was pleased with the believers when they gave the Bai‘ah
under the tree: He knew what was in their hearts, and He sent down As-Sakînah
upon them, and He rewarded them with a near victory.

48:19.text: And abundant spoils that they will capture. And Allâh is Ever All-Mighty, All-Wise.

48:20.text: Allâh has promised you abundant spoils that you will capture, and He has hastened for you this, and He has restrained the hands of men from you: that it may be a sign for the believers, and that He may guide you to the Straight Path.

48:21.text: (victories and much booty He promises you)
which are not yet within your power; indeed Allâh compasses them. And Allâh is Ever Able to do all things.

48:22.text: And if those who disbelieve fight against you, they certainly would have turned their backs; then they would have found neither a Walî

48:23.text: That has been the Way of Allâh already with those who passed away before. And you will not find any change in the Way of Allâh.
